title: Typhoon's Shadow: An Orphan's Resolve
summary: Under an intermediate green sky, a nubuck tent offered a watchful teenager meager shelter from a looming typhoon, jamming signals from a distant nemesis. With unbridled imagination, the teenager, an unloved orphan, pieced together fanjets from tangled parts, uplifted by the undeniable progress under murky twin suns. In the crowded, humid jungle, the teenager chewed pepper, surrounded by fireflies and opals as an ultimate vampire-like presence, the opposite of everything good, rotated around them. Below the watchtower, people, no longer understaffed and frantic, worked together, their rage now purpose. New wizards and science elevated levels, with only whiffs of past struggle remaining.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a vast outdoor wasteland under an intermediate, green sky. A colossal, brooding typhoon cloud, thicker than any storm, looms in the distance with an unsettling opacity. In the foreground, a humble nubuck tent provides meager shelter. A lone teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, and oil-stained mechanic coveralls, sits watchfully, preparing fajitas over a small fire. Shadows of what appear to be ninjas move like a vector on the horizon, creating breakpoints. A harmless, pinhead-sized drone hovers at a lower level, jamming faint signals from an unseen nemesis. The landscape hints at a hidden, potty-like secret onside, just out of immediate view. The overall aesthetic is vibrant high-contrast concept art, like Moebius meets Craig Mullins, with warm golden hour lighting.
